bundle.longDescription:
UnENVerse keeps API keys, passwords, certificates, SSH keys, connection strings and authenticator seeds in a single SQLCipher database encrypted with a key derived from your master password by Argon2id. The key is derived on your machine and never written to disk.

It stores credentials with the structure they actually have - provider, environment, scopes, rate limits, expiry, rotation cadence - and renders them into the config formats that consume them: .env files, Docker Compose, WireGuard, nginx, Kubernetes secrets, Terraform tfvars and more, with cross-references between entries resolved on the way out.

Built-in TOTP authenticator with import and export for Ente Auth, Aegis, 2FAS, andOTP, Bitwarden and Google Authenticator. Optional self-hosted server with TLS and certificate pinning, sub-users, role-based access control and a hash-chained audit log. Ships with unv, a CLI designed so that automation can wire credentials into configuration without a secret ever passing through the calling process.
